# Copilot Instructions

## General Guidelines
- First copy complete tutorial code.
- Update legacy code.
- Perform folder-structure separation and save-path options afterward.
- Ensure UI architecture is easy to design without code-heavy dynamic control generation, allowing the design team to edit UI via Visual Studio drag-and-drop Designer. Use Visual Studio Designer-based forms (design-time controls) instead of runtime dynamic control creation to focus on functionality code-behind.

## Code Style
- Use specific formatting rules.
- Follow naming conventions.
